dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, it's Eula and... Clorinde? You're here in Mondstadt?

dialogues.speaker: Clorinde
dialogues.text: Yes. I received an invitation to exchange swordsmanship techniques. I'd heard of the single-handed sword form of Favonius Bladework...

dialogues.speaker: Clorinde
dialogues.text: But after crossing swords with Miss Eula, it turns out the Knights of Favonius are quite accomplished with the greatsword as well.

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: You're quite an accomplished swordsman yourself, although I suppose that's to be expected of the Champion Duelist. Even over a few short rounds, I feel like we've learned a lot from each other.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: This is a good place to spar.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: For sure. You don't have to worry about breaking stuff or accidentally hurting anyone nearby.

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: That's right. There also appear to be automatic harpasta launchers in the area.

dialogues.speaker: Clorinde
dialogues.text: Ah, that's one of your local traditions, isn't it? Shall we have ourselves a game, then?

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: Why not? You should know, though. I'm not easy to beat at this game.

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: Ah, hold on! No muskets allowed!

dialogues.speaker: Clorinde
dialogues.text: Oh, uh... Why not? Doesn't it still count as "hitting the harpastum"?
